versions.changelog:
Initial release — fetches and displays the latest top 10 AI news headlines.

- Retrieves and lists the most recent AI news headlines for users.
- Collects headlines from multiple dates if needed to ensure a full top 10.
- Forces browser refresh to ensure up-to-date results.
- Presents headlines in a clear, numbered list with current date.
- Handles page popups automatically to ensure uninterrupted data collection.
